skill.name: youtube-summarizer
skill.description: Extract YouTube transcripts and turn public videos with captions into detailed Markdown summaries for study, research, and documentation.
skill.summary: Summarizes YouTube transcripts into structured notes and reference material.
skill.author: Eric Andrade

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown examples, code fences, URLs, and installation documentation. Confirmed risks remain around predictable /tmp transcript files, untrusted transcript text being fed to an AI summarization prompt, and automatic third-party package installation. No prompt injection control text was found in the skill files.

remediation.suggestion: Validate video IDs with a strict allowlist such as A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore, and hyphen. Use a safe temp-file API or a private working directory instead of predictable /tmp names.
Treat transcript text as untrusted source material. Tell the AI to summarize the content only and ignore instructions embedded in the transcript.
Require explicit confirmation before running pip. Pin dependency versions and recommend a virtual environment or manual installation path.
Update skill metadata and documentation to disclose network access, filesystem writes, and external package installation.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Transcript Prompt Injection Surface
semantic_findings.description: The skill extracts YouTube transcript text and directs the AI model to use it as summarization input without defining an untrusted-content boundary. A malicious transcript could contain instructions that try to override the summarization workflow.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow joins transcript text and applies an AI prompt to it. The reviewed sections do not instruct the agent to ignore instructions embedded inside transcript content.

semantic_findings.title: Automatic Third-Party Package Installation
semantic_findings.description: The installer runs pip or pip3 to install youtube-transcript-api in the active environment. This is expected functionality, but it pulls third-party code and changes the user environment.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The shell script directly invokes pip3 install or pip install. The README also describes automatic dependency installation as normal behavior.

content.user_title: Summarize YouTube Videos into Detailed Notes
content.value_statement: Long videos are hard to review and cite later. This skill extracts YouTube transcripts and creates structured summaries for research, learning, and documentation.
actual_capabilities: Extracts transcripts from public YouTube videos using youtube-transcript-api.
Recognizes common youtube.com, youtu.be, and mobile YouTube URL formats.
Checks whether transcripts are available and reports clear errors when they are not.
Prefers Portuguese transcripts and falls back to English when configured that way.
Guides the AI to produce detailed Markdown summaries with insights, concepts, and conclusions.
Provides optional dependency setup guidance for Python and youtube-transcript-api.
limitations: Requires a public YouTube video with captions or an available transcript.
Depends on Python, pip, and the third-party youtube-transcript-api package.
Does not download video or audio files.
Very long transcripts may exceed the active model context window.

use_cases.title: Study Lecture Videos
use_cases.description: Convert a public lecture transcript into organized notes with key concepts, terminology, and conclusions.

use_cases.title: Document Technical Tutorials
use_cases.description: Turn a tutorial transcript into a step-by-step reference for commands, decisions, and troubleshooting points.

use_cases.title: Review Research Talks
use_cases.description: Capture claims, methods, examples, and follow-up questions from conference talks or expert interviews.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize One Video
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single public video.
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize this YouTube video: [URL]. Include the main ideas, key terms, and final takeaways.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Transcript First
prompt_templates.scenario: User wants source text before the summary.
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the transcript from this YouTube video: [URL]. Then create a concise summary with important timestamps when available.

prompt_templates.title: Create Study Notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize this lecture: [URL]. Organize the output as study notes with concepts, definitions, examples, and review questions.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Technical Talk
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for deep content review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this technical talk: [URL]. Identify the thesis, evidence, tradeoffs, assumptions, risks, and practical next steps.

output_examples.input: A public lecture video about machine learning basics.
output: Executive summary of the lecture topic and audience.
Detailed sections for core ideas, examples, and terminology.
Final takeaways and suggested follow-up questions.

output_examples.input: A developer tutorial video with captions enabled.
output: Important commands and decisions mentioned by the presenter.

output_examples.input: A YouTube URL without available transcripts.
output_examples.output: The skill reports that no transcript is available and asks the user to try another public video with captions.

best_practices: Use public videos with reliable captions for the best transcript quality.
Ask for the summary format you need before processing the transcript.
Review generated notes against the original video before citing them.
anti_patterns: Do not use it for private, restricted, or transcript-disabled videos.
Do not treat generated summaries as exact quotations from the speaker.
Do not run automatic dependency installation without reviewing the environment impact.

faq.question: Does this skill download YouTube videos?
faq.answer: No. It extracts text transcripts through youtube-transcript-api and does not download video or audio files.

faq.question: Which videos work best?
faq.answer: Public videos with manual captions or reliable auto-generated captions work best.

faq.question: Can it summarize videos in languages other than English?
faq.answer: Yes, when a transcript is available. The documented workflow can prefer Portuguese and fall back to English.

faq.question: What tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: The skill needs Python, pip, and the youtube-transcript-api package.

faq.question: Can summaries include the raw transcript?
faq.answer: The documentation describes options for summary-only, transcript-only, or combined output.
